events.title: London Chess League Summer Congress
events.description:
5-round Summer Congress on Tuesday nights for five Tuesdays. 60m+30s standard, ECF rated (not FIDE rated) game in a relaxed environment, great for preparing for the new chess season!
Start time: All rounds have a scheduled start at 18.30 (6:30pm)
Time control: 60 minutes + 30 seconds per move (60+30)
Sections: If 25 or more players sign up, Open, U2000 and U1600. If <25 players register, then Open + U1900 section

events.title: Chiltern & Bucks Junior Chess – LJCC Qualifier
events.description:
The London Junior Chess Championships (LJCC) is one of the country’s most prestigious junior chess events.
Chiltern & Bucks Junior Chess is a LJCC qualifier tournament for U8, U10 & U12 age groups only.
Note: There is no prior qualification necessary for the U14 events and above.
Online entry: https://forms.gle/Dko1nbZYD8MNs48M9

events.title: Women’s & Girls’ FIDE / ECF Classical Congress
events.description:
London Women Chess Club is delighted to present another round of the Women’s & Girls’ FIDE & ECF Classical Congress. A friendly and welcoming 5-round classical tournament (60+15) for players of all abilities, held in three rating sections. The event is both FIDE and ECF rated, with live boards and commentary on Chess.com. Whether you’re an experienced competitor or playing your first classical event, we look forward to welcoming you for a fantastic weekend of chess.
Entry form: https://britchess.wufoo.com/cabinet/faaef638-3df0-4f79-b539-55bec1e798e1

venue.venue: London Women Chess Club – Pancras Square Library

events.title: 2026 Rhyl Chess Congress
events.description:
5 Round Swiss Tournament with 3 Sections; Open, Major U1850 & Minor U1600.
The Congress will be a FIDE, WCU and ECF registered event.
We welcome all players from all the U.K. federations.
All sections will be rated by the WCU, ECF and FIDE.
Online entry: https://www.rhylchesscongress.co.uk/
